main_text.p: פרת m. Euphrates, fluvius quartus paradisi, Genesis 2. v.14. Græcè Εὐφράτης[?], quod putant factum ex הוא פרת. Talmudici: Quare vocatur פרת? שמימין פרים[?] ורבים Quia aquæ ejus fructificant & crescunt.
פרתמים m.p. Proceres, Præfecti, Dominatores; Dan.1.3. Esth.1.3. R. Salomon scribit, linguâ Persicâ esse idem quod שלטונים[?] Dominatores.
פשה Expandit, Diffudit se: Præter. פָּשָׂה הַנִּנַּע Diffudit se plaga; Levit.13.5. פָּשְׂתָה Diffudit se; v.8. Futur. & Infinit. יִפְשֶׂה פָּשֹׁה Diffundendo diffudit se, v.35.

פשח Pih. פִּשַּׁח Discerpsit, Discidit: Futurum, וִיפַשְּׁחֵנִי Et discerpsit me, Thren.3.11. Proprie Chaldaicum est: ut, וּפִשַּׁח שְׁמוּאֵל Et discerpsit Samuel Agagum, 1.Sam.15. v.33. Syrè נְפַשְּׁחוּנֵהּ Discerpent eum, Luc.23.11. & alibi.

פשט Exuit, Detraxit, Nudavit, Spoliavit: Irruit, Irrupit, Diffudit se, Grassatus est: Construitur cum Accusat. & Præpositione על, אל, ב & ב. Præter. פָּשַׁט Irruit latro, Hos.7.1. וּפָשְׁטָה Et irrues, Jud. 9.33. פָּשַׁטְתִּי Exui tunicam meam, Cantic.5.3. Infinitiv. פְּשֹׁטָה Spoliare, Jesa.32.11. pro לִפְשׁוֹט, cum ה paragogico, antecedente Cholem, præter normam. Est autem Infinitivus pro Imperativo, פְּשׁוּטֵנָּה Spoliate. Simile in ערה[?]. Pih. Infinit. לְפַשֵּׁט Ad spoliandum, 1.Sam.31.8. Hiph. Præter. הִפְשִׁיט Detraxit, Job.19.9. וְהִפְשִׁיט Et detrahet, scil. pellem, id est, excoriabit, Levit.1.6. וְהִפְשִׁיטוּ Et exuent te, Ezech.16.39. Hithp. Futurum, יִתְפַּשַּׁט Et exuit se; 1.Sam.18.4.
פשע Defecit, Prævaricatus est, Rebellavit: Latius proprie patet, quàm מָרַד. Aben Esra scribit Hos.14.10. פּוֹשְׁעִים שִׁיּוֹצְאִים מֵהָרְשׁוֹת esse qui egre-diuntur.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied from a low-resolution scan; vowel points and some letters are uncertain and marked [?]. The Greek word after "Græcè" and the Hebrew "שמימין" in the Talmudic citation are doubtful. "שלטונים" and "ערה" are doubtful. Line ends are reconstructed: "egre-" / "diuntur" joined. The printed Hebrew words "פרת" and "פשה" are headwords printed large in the left margin; they are included in the entries where they open each paragraph.
